name: Weaviate
desc: Open-source vector database with native hybrid keyword-vector search.
desc_zh: 开源自托管向量数据库，原生支持关键词与向量混合检索。
solves: Pure vector search misses the exact keyword you needed. It runs keyword and vector search together in one query.
solves_zh: 纯向量检索会漏掉你要的那个准确关键词。它在一次查询里同时跑关键词和向量检索。
best_for: When data sovereignty rules out a managed vector store but you still want hybrid retrieval.
best_for_zh: 数据主权要求排除了托管式向量库、但又仍然需要混合检索的时候。
notes: The open-source option when data sovereignty rules out managed vector stores. 来源：https://weaviate.io/developers/weaviate/current/roadmap
